title: SAP and planqc Demonstrate Enterprise Software Integration and Quantum Agents at Quantum Day Munich - Quantum Computing Report
gist: SAP and neutral-atom developer planqc showed, for the first time, an end-to-end cloud integration that connects SAP's enterprise software with planqc's quantum stack. In a live demo they solved a truck-loading bin-packing problem on planqc's simulator. SAP also introduced its first Quantum Agents and plans a Munich quantum team, with business workloads to be tested on planqc hardware starting in 2027.

insights.claim: SAP and planqc have demonstrated, for the first time, an end-to-end cloud integration that links SAP's enterprise software environment with planqc's quantum computing stack.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: SAP is building a path for quantum compute to reach its large enterprise installed base, with planqc as its first hardware partner.

insights.claim: The SAP-planqc hybrid architecture connects classical solvers, quantum simulators and quantum hardware. Enterprise applications can hand off complex optimization problems to it and receive the results directly in their operational workflows.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: The near-term enterprise quantum model is a hybrid solver call built into existing ERP workflows, not a standalone quantum application.
insights.quote: offload complex optimization problems and return computed results directly into operational workflows
insights.locator: Unveiled at SAP's Quantum Day Munich

insights.claim: In a live demo, SAP and planqc ran a multi-constraint bin-packing logistics workflow on planqc's quantum simulator, not on real quantum hardware. The workflow optimized how a beverage delivery truck is loaded across compartment capacities, unloading directions and refrigeration requirements.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: The demo ran on a simulator, so it shows integration readiness rather than any quantum advantage on hardware.

insights.claim: SAP has introduced its first Quantum Agents. They capture business constraints and orchestrate hybrid solvers so that end users do not need to write quantum code.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: SAP is using an agent-style interface to make quantum accessible to non-specialists, which is how the quantum and AI-agent narratives meet in enterprise software.
